operation.body:
### Goal

Handle invalid requests safely (FR-006): reject unsupported category values and requests for missing feedback items without corrupting stored data, and keep the submission flow usable after errors.

### Acceptance criteria

- `show` and `update` for a non-existent feedback id return a user-visible not-found response (no 500); stored data for other items is unchanged.
- Invalid category updates continue to show readable errors, preserve the item’s stored category and active filter context, and allow a subsequent valid new submission (per `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` acceptance details).
- Controller/integration tests cover missing-item handling and the invalid-category recovery path (form action/method on the submission form after a failed category change).
- Pull request contains exact `Closes #<this-issue-number>` and stays within FR-006 scope.
- `bin/rails test` passes; no regression to FR-001–FR-005 behaviour.

### Constraints

- Ruby on Rails, SQLite, server-rendered HTML; MIT license; no authentication.
- Build on current `main` at `9cc8066` (goals #4/#9/#11/#13/#15/#17 merged).
- Do not edit `docs/security-review.md` or implement goal #3 work.
- Keep CI economical; prefer focused controller tests and minimal app changes.

### Out of scope

- FR-007 test-gap audit beyond FR-006 scenarios, FR-008 documentation/sample-data sweep, new product features, and demo recording.

### Relevant context

Category validation and invalid-category update rendering exist from FR-003; missing-item handling may still raise `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound`. Parent project #2 targets FR-001–FR-008 overall.
